## Configuration

```{r config}
CFG <- list(
  data_path   = "ProbioticSpike.xlsx",
  data_range  = "A2:G6",
  results_dir = "results",
  fig_dir     = "figures",
  strains = tribble(
    ~sheet,       ~strain,                     ~label,
    "B.infantis", "B. longum subsp. infantis", "B. infantis",
    "B.longum",   "B. longum subsp. longum",   "B. longum",
    "B.bifidum",  "B. bifidum",                "B. bifidum",
    "B.breve",    "B. breve",                  "B. breve"
  ),
  condition_map = c(Anaerobic = "Reduced oxygen", Anareobic = "Reduced oxygen", Aerobic = "Aerobic"),
  conditions    = c("Reduced oxygen", "Aerobic"),
  days          = c(0, 1, 3, 7),
  n_rep         = 3,
  baseline_day  = 0,
  endpoint_day  = 7,
  df_contrast   = 4,
  conf_level    = 0.95,
  strain_cols   = c("B. infantis" = "#3B75AF", "B. longum" = "#519E3E",
                    "B. bifidum"  = "#8D69B8", "B. breve"  = "#C53A32"),
  cond_cols     = c("Reduced oxygen" = "#3B75AF", "Aerobic" = "#CA6627"),
  cond_lty      = c("Reduced oxygen" = "dashed", "Aerobic" = "solid"),
  fold_breaks   = c(1, 10, 100, 1000),
  fold_limits   = c(0.8, 500),
  change_breaks = seq(-2.5, 0, 0.5),
  fig_w_mm      = 183,
  fig_h_mm      = 150,
  base_size     = 9
)

dir.create(CFG$results_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(CFG$fig_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Helpers

```{r helpers}
read_strain <- function(sheet) {
  m <- read_excel(CFG$data_path, sheet = sheet, range = CFG$data_range,
                  col_names = FALSE, .name_repair = "minimal")
  raw_labels <- trimws(unlist(m[1, c(2, 5)]))
  if (!all(raw_labels %in% names(CFG$condition_map)))
    stop("Unrecognised condition label in sheet ", sheet, ": ",
         paste(raw_labels, collapse = ", "))
  vals <- m[-1, ]
  tibble(day       = rep(as.numeric(unlist(vals[, 1])), times = 6),
         col       = rep(2:7, each = nrow(vals)),
         CFU_per_mL = as.numeric(unlist(vals[, 2:7]))) |>
    mutate(condition = unname(CFG$condition_map[raw_labels[ifelse(col <= 4, 1, 2)]]),
           replicate = (col - 2) %% 3 + 1,
           sheet     = sheet) |>
    select(-col)
}

holm_sidak <- function(p) {
  n <- length(p); o <- order(p)
  adj <- cummax(1 - (1 - p[o])^(n - seq_len(n) + 1))
  out <- numeric(n); out[o] <- pmin(1, adj); out
}

p_star <- function(p) {
  case_when(is.na(p) ~ "",
            p < 0.0001 ~ "****", p < 0.001 ~ "***",
            p < 0.01 ~ "**", p < 0.05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ "n.s.")
}

fold_label <- function(x) paste0(comma(x, accuracy = 1), "\u00d7")

theme_pub <- function(base = CFG$base_size) {
  theme_classic(base_size = base) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.line        = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
      axis.ticks       = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.text        = element_text(colour = "black"),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text       = element_text(face = "italic", size = base + 1),
      legend.key.width = unit(10, "mm"),
      plot.tag         = element_text(face = "bold", size = base + 6),
      plot.margin      = margin(4, 6, 4, 4)
    )
}

save_fig <- function(plot, name, w_mm, h_mm, out_dir = CFG$fig_dir) {
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(name, ".png")), plot,
         width = w_mm, height = h_mm, units = "mm", dpi = 600, bg = "white")
  ok <- tryCatch({
    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(name, ".pdf")), plot,
           width = w_mm, height = h_mm, units = "mm",
           device = grDevices::cairo_pdf)
    TRUE
  }, error = function(e) FALSE)
  if (!ok) ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(name, ".pdf")), plot,
                  width = w_mm, height = h_mm, units = "mm")
  invisible(plot)
}

write_res <- function(df, metric_type) {
  write.csv(df, file.path(CFG$results_dir, paste0(metric_type, ".csv")),
            row.names = FALSE)
}
```

## Data

```{r data}
# Read the data
missing_sheets <- setdiff(CFG$strains$sheet, excel_sheets(CFG$data_path))
if (length(missing_sheets)) stop("Missing sheets: ", paste(missing_sheets, collapse = ", "))

cfu <- map_dfr(CFG$strains$sheet, read_strain) |>
  left_join(CFG$strains, by = "sheet") |>
  mutate(strain    = factor(strain, levels = CFG$strains$strain),
         label     = factor(label, levels = CFG$strains$label),
         condition = factor(condition, levels = CFG$conditions),
         log10_cfu = log10(CFU_per_mL)) |>
  select(strain, label, condition, day, replicate, CFU_per_mL, log10_cfu)

# Check the data
stopifnot(
  "Unexpected days"               = all(sort(unique(cfu$day)) == CFG$days),
  "Missing or non-positive counts" = all(is.finite(cfu$CFU_per_mL) & cfu$CFU_per_mL > 0),
  "Duplicate cells"               = !anyDuplicated(cfu[c("strain", "condition", "day", "replicate")]),
  "Each sheet needs both conditions" = all(table(cfu$strain, cfu$condition) > 0),
  "Unexpected replicate count"    = all(count(cfu, strain, condition, day)$n == CFG$n_rep)
)

cfu
```

## Baseline-normalised values and descriptives

```{r descriptives}
# Normalise to each replicate's own day-0 count
normalised <- cfu |>
  group_by(strain, condition, replicate) |>
  mutate(log10_change = log10_cfu - log10_cfu[day == CFG$baseline_day]) |>
  ungroup()

descriptives <- normalised |>
  group_by(strain, label, condition, day) |>
  summarise(n                 = n(),
            mean_log10_cfu    = mean(log10_cfu),
            sd_log10_cfu      = sd(log10_cfu),
            mean_log10_change = mean(log10_change),
            sd_log10_change   = sd(log10_change),
            .groups = "drop")

write_res(select(normalised, strain, condition, day, replicate, CFU_per_mL, log10_change),
          "CFU_baseline_normalised")
write_res(select(descriptives, -label), "CFU_descriptives")
descriptives
```

## Primary statistics

```{r stats}
# Calculate stats
fit_strain <- function(x) {
  x <- mutate(x, cell = factor(paste(condition, day, sep = "_")),
                 unit = factor(paste(condition, replicate, sep = "_")))
  fit <- lme(log10_cfu ~ 0 + cell, random = ~ 1 | unit, data = x, method = "REML")
  list(b = fixef(fit), V = vcov(fit))
}

contrast_row <- function(fit, weights, df = CFG$df_contrast) {
  L <- setNames(numeric(length(fit$b)), names(fit$b))
  L[paste0("cell", names(weights))] <- weights
  est <- sum(L * fit$b)
  se  <- sqrt(drop(t(L) %*% fit$V %*% L))
  q   <- qt(1 - (1 - CFG$conf_level) / 2, df)
  tibble(fold = 10^est, ci_lower = 10^(est - q * se), ci_upper = 10^(est + q * se),
         t = est / se, df = df, p_value = 2 * pt(-abs(est / se), df))
}

cell <- function(cond, day) paste(cond, day, sep = "_")

fits <- cfu |> group_by(strain) |> group_map(~ fit_strain(.x), .keep = TRUE) |>
  setNames(levels(cfu$strain))

stats <- map_dfr(levels(cfu$strain), function(s) {
  map_dfr(CFG$days, function(d) {
    contrast_row(fits[[s]], setNames(c(1, -1), cell(CFG$conditions, d))) |>
      mutate(strain = s, day = d, .before = 1)
  }) |>
    mutate(p_adj = holm_sidak(p_value))
}) |>
  left_join(count(cfu, strain, condition, day) |>
              pivot_wider(names_from = condition, values_from = n) |>
              rename(n_reduced_oxygen = `Reduced oxygen`, n_aerobic = Aerobic) |>
              mutate(strain = as.character(strain)),
            by = c("strain", "day")) |>
  mutate(stars = p_star(p_adj)) |>
  select(strain, day, n_reduced_oxygen, n_aerobic, fold, ci_lower, ci_upper, t, df,
         p_value, p_adj, stars)

write_res(stats, "CFU_statistics")
stats
```

## Sensitivity

```{r sensitivity}
# Welch t-test at each day
welch <- cfu |>
  group_by(strain, day) |>
  group_modify(function(x, key) {
    a  <- x$log10_cfu[x$condition == "Reduced oxygen"]
    b  <- x$log10_cfu[x$condition == "Aerobic"]
    if (sd(a) == 0 && sd(b) == 0)
      return(tibble(n_reduced_oxygen = length(a), n_aerobic = length(b),
                    fold = 10^(mean(a) - mean(b)), ci_lower = NA_real_, ci_upper = NA_real_,
                    t = NA_real_, df = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_))
    tt <- t.test(a, b, var.equal = FALSE, conf.level = CFG$conf_level)
    tibble(n_reduced_oxygen = length(a), n_aerobic = length(b),
           fold = 10^(mean(a) - mean(b)),
           ci_lower = 10^tt$conf.int[1], ci_upper = 10^tt$conf.int[2],
           t = unname(tt$statistic), df = unname(tt$parameter), p_value = tt$p.value)
  }) |>
  group_by(strain) |>
  mutate(p_adj = replace(p_value, !is.na(p_value), holm_sidak(na.omit(p_value))),
         test = "Welch t-test") |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(strain = as.character(strain))

# Mixed model on change from day 0
change <- map_dfr(levels(cfu$strain), function(s) {
  map_dfr(setdiff(CFG$days, CFG$baseline_day), function(d) {
    w <- setNames(c(1, -1, -1, 1),
                  c(cell("Reduced oxygen", d), cell("Reduced oxygen", CFG$baseline_day),
                    cell("Aerobic", d),    cell("Aerobic", CFG$baseline_day)))
    contrast_row(fits[[s]], w) |> mutate(strain = s, day = d, .before = 1)
  }) |>
    mutate(p_adj = holm_sidak(p_value))
}) |>
  mutate(n_reduced_oxygen = CFG$n_rep, n_aerobic = CFG$n_rep,
         test = "Mixed model, change from day 0")

sensitivity <- bind_rows(welch, change) |>
  mutate(stars = p_star(p_adj)) |>
  select(strain, test, day, n_reduced_oxygen, n_aerobic, fold, ci_lower, ci_upper,
         t, df, p_value, p_adj, stars)

write_res(sensitivity, "CFU_sensitivity")
sensitivity
```

## Figure

```{r figure, fig.width = CFG$fig_w_mm / 25.4, fig.height = CFG$fig_h_mm / 25.4}
# Panel A
d7 <- stats |>
  filter(day == CFG$endpoint_day) |>
  left_join(select(CFG$strains, strain, label), by = "strain") |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = rev(CFG$strains$label)))

panel_a <- ggplot(d7, aes(y = label, colour = label)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = ci_lower, xend = ci_upper, yend = label), linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(aes(x = fold), shape = 18, size = 3) +
  geom_text(aes(x = ci_upper * 1.2, label = stars), hjust = 0, vjust = 0.25,
            colour = "black", size = CFG$base_size / .pt) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = CFG$fold_breaks, labels = fold_label, limits = CFG$fold_limits,
                expand = expansion(0)) +
  annotation_logticks(sides = "b", outside = FALSE, linewidth = 0.3,
                      short = unit(0.6, "mm"), mid = unit(1, "mm"), long = unit(1.5, "mm")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = CFG$strain_cols, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Fold difference in viable CFU/mL at day 7 (reduced oxygen/aerobic)", y = NULL) +
  theme_pub() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic", size = CFG$base_size + 1),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())

# Panel B
band <- descriptives |>
  mutate(lower = mean_log10_change - sd_log10_change,
         upper = mean_log10_change + sd_log10_change)

brackets <- band |>
  select(strain, label, condition, day, mean_log10_change) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = condition, values_from = mean_log10_change) |>
  mutate(strain = as.character(strain)) |>
  left_join(select(stats, strain, day, p_adj, stars), by = c("strain", "day")) |>
  filter(p_adj < 0.05)

panel_b <- ggplot(band, aes(day, mean_log10_change, colour = condition,
                            fill = condition, linetype = condition)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.18, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(size = 1.2) +
  geom_segment(data = brackets,
               aes(x = day, xend = day, y = `Reduced oxygen`, yend = Aerobic),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_text(data = brackets,
            aes(x = day + 0.15, y = (`Reduced oxygen` + Aerobic) / 2, label = stars),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, size = CFG$base_size / .pt) +
  facet_wrap(~ label, nrow = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = CFG$days, expand = expansion(add = c(0.3, 0.6))) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = CFG$change_breaks) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = CFG$cond_cols, name = NULL) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = CFG$cond_cols, name = NULL) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = CFG$cond_lty, name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Time (days)",
       y = expression(atop(log[10]~"change from", "condition-specific baseline"))) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_pub() +
  theme(legend.position = "top", legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
        legend.box.spacing = unit(1, "mm"), panel.spacing.x = unit(7, "mm"),
        plot.margin = margin(4, 16, 4, 4))

# Combine and save
fig <- panel_a / panel_b +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1.4)) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")

save_fig(fig, "bifidobacteria_preservation", CFG$fig_w_mm, CFG$fig_h_mm)
fig
```
